Cursor11 V3.0.0

After extracting, double-click Install Cursor11.exe in the root folder.

The installer provides two actions:
- Install Cursor11: installs the light set with white glyphs and black outlines.
- Restore Defaults: restores Windows Aero cursors and the default scheme name.

This is the English release package.

Design:
- Beam B with 15 px standard caps and the stem shortened by 6%.
- Existing silhouettes retained for non-directional cursors.
- Enlarged directional glyphs with an approximately 8 px gap.
- Light theme only.

Recommended setup:
1. Install Cursor11 and confirm all cursor roles.
2. Run Restore Defaults and confirm Windows Aero is restored.
3. Install Cursor11 again.

Original concept design: Jepri Creations
https://www.deviantart.com/jepricreations

This release has passed installation, restore, and reinstall testing.
